accountMail.intro.twoFactorDisabled.zh-TW: 這個帳號的雙因素驗證已關閉。
accountMail.intro.twoFactorDisabled.en-US: Two-factor authentication was turned off for this account.
accountMail.intro.twoFactorDisabled.th: การยืนยันตัวตนสองขั้นตอนของบัญชีนี้ถูกปิดแล้ว
accountMail.intro.twoFactorDisabled.vi: Xác thực hai yếu tố của tài khoản này đã bị tắt.

accountMail.intro.passwordReset.zh-TW: 有人申請重設這個帳號的密碼。要重設請開啟下面的連結：
accountMail.intro.passwordReset.en-US: Someone asked to reset the password for this account. To reset it, open the link below:
accountMail.intro.passwordReset.th: มีผู้ขอรีเซ็ตรหัสผ่านของบัญชีนี้ หากต้องการรีเซ็ต โปรดเปิดลิงก์ด้านล่าง:
accountMail.intro.passwordReset.vi: Có người yêu cầu đặt lại mật khẩu cho tài khoản này. Để đặt lại, hãy mở liên kết bên dưới:

accountMail.ByAdmin.th: เปลี่ยนโดยผู้ดูแลระบบ
accountMail.ByAdmin.vi: do quản trị viên hệ thống thay đổi

accountMail.subject.passwordReset.th: รีเซ็ตรหัสผ่าน

accountMail.subject.twoFactorDisabled.zh-TW: 你的雙因素驗證已關閉
accountMail.subject.twoFactorDisabled.en-US: Your two-factor authentication was turned off
accountMail.subject.twoFactorDisabled.th: การยืนยันตัวตนสองขั้นตอนของคุณถูกปิดแล้ว
accountMail.subject.twoFactorDisabled.vi: Xác thực hai yếu tố của bạn đã bị tắt

accountMail.subject.twoFactorFailures.zh-TW: 你的帳號驗證碼錯誤次數過多
accountMail.subject.twoFactorFailures.en-US: Too many wrong verification codes on your account
accountMail.subject.twoFactorFailures.th: รหัสยืนยันของบัญชีคุณผิดหลายครั้งเกินไป
accountMail.subject.twoFactorFailures.vi: Tài khoản của bạn nhập sai mã xác minh quá nhiều lần

ReauthThrottled.zh-TW: 嘗試次數過多，請稍後再試
ReauthThrottled.en-US: Too many attempts. Try again later
ReauthThrottled.th: พยายามหลายครั้งเกินไป โปรดลองใหม่ภายหลัง
ReauthThrottled.vi: Thử quá nhiều lần, vui lòng thử lại sau

accountMail.intro.recoveryCodeUsed.zh-TW: 有人用一組復原碼登入了這個帳號，這組復原碼已不能再用。
accountMail.intro.recoveryCodeUsed.en-US: Someone signed in to this account with a recovery code. That code can no longer be used.
accountMail.intro.recoveryCodeUsed.th: มีผู้เข้าสู่ระบบบัญชีนี้ด้วยรหัสกู้คืน รหัสนั้นใช้ไม่ได้อีกแล้ว
accountMail.intro.recoveryCodeUsed.vi: Có người đăng nhập vào tài khoản này bằng một mã khôi phục; mã đó không dùng được nữa.

EmailNotPending.en-US: There is no email waiting to be verified
EmailNotPending.th: ไม่มีอีเมลที่รอการยืนยัน
EmailNotPending.vi: Không có email nào đang chờ xác minh

accountMail.intro.emailVerify.zh-TW: 請開啟下面的連結驗證這個 Email。驗證之後，重設密碼與安全通知才會寄到這裡：
accountMail.intro.emailVerify.en-US: Open the link below to verify this email. Password resets and security notices are sent here only after it is verified:
accountMail.intro.emailVerify.th: โปรดเปิดลิงก์ด้านล่างเพื่อยืนยันอีเมลนี้ อีเมลรีเซ็ตรหัสผ่านและการแจ้งเตือนความปลอดภัยจะส่งมาที่นี่หลังยืนยันแล้วเท่านั้น:
accountMail.intro.emailVerify.vi: Mở liên kết bên dưới để xác minh email này. Chỉ sau khi xác minh, thư đặt lại mật khẩu và thông báo bảo mật mới được gửi đến đây:

EmailVerifyLinkInvalid.zh-TW: 連結已失效或已使用過
EmailVerifyLinkInvalid.en-US: The link has expired or has already been used
EmailVerifyLinkInvalid.th: ลิงก์หมดอายุหรือถูกใช้ไปแล้ว
EmailVerifyLinkInvalid.vi: Liên kết đã hết hạn hoặc đã được sử dụng

accountMail.intro.twoFactorEnabled.zh-TW: 這個帳號啟用了雙因素驗證，之後登入要輸入驗證器 App 的驗證碼。
accountMail.intro.twoFactorEnabled.en-US: Two-factor authentication was turned on for this account. Signing in now requires a code from an authenticator app.
accountMail.intro.twoFactorEnabled.th: บัญชีนี้เปิดใช้การยืนยันตัวตนสองขั้นตอนแล้ว การเข้าสู่ระบบต่อจากนี้ต้องใช้รหัสจากแอปยืนยันตัวตน
accountMail.intro.twoFactorEnabled.vi: Tài khoản này đã bật xác thực hai yếu tố; từ nay đăng nhập cần mã từ ứng dụng xác thực.

accountMail.BySelf.th: เปลี่ยนโดยคุณเอง

accountMail.intro.emailChanged.zh-TW: 這個帳號的 Email 已改成其他地址（{0}），之後的帳號信不會再寄到這裡。
accountMail.intro.emailChanged.en-US: The email for this account was changed to another address ({0}). Account emails will no longer be sent here.
accountMail.intro.emailChanged.th: อีเมลของบัญชีนี้ถูกเปลี่ยนเป็นที่อยู่อื่นแล้ว ({0}) อีเมลบัญชีต่อจากนี้จะไม่ส่งมาที่นี่อีก
accountMail.intro.emailChanged.vi: Email của tài khoản này đã được đổi sang địa chỉ khác ({0}). Thư tài khoản sẽ không còn gửi đến đây nữa.

accountMail.LinkHours.zh-TW: 連結 {0} 小時內有效，只能使用一次。
accountMail.LinkHours.en-US: The link is valid for {0} hours and can be used only once.
accountMail.LinkHours.th: ลิงก์ใช้ได้ภายใน {0} ชั่วโมงและใช้ได้เพียงครั้งเดียว
accountMail.LinkHours.vi: Liên kết có hiệu lực trong {0} giờ và chỉ dùng được một lần.

accountMail.subject.twoFactorEnabled.th: คุณเปิดใช้การยืนยันตัวตนสองขั้นตอนแล้ว
accountMail.subject.twoFactorEnabled.vi: Bạn đã bật xác thực hai yếu tố

accountMail.subject.passwordChanged.th: รหัสผ่านของคุณถูกเปลี่ยนแล้ว
accountMail.subject.passwordChanged.vi: Mật khẩu của bạn đã được thay đổi

accountMail.NotYou.zh-TW: 如果不是你本人操作，請聯絡系統管理員。
accountMail.NotYou.en-US: If this was not you, contact your system administrator.
accountMail.NotYou.th: หากไม่ใช่คุณเป็นผู้ดำเนินการ โปรดติดต่อผู้ดูแลระบบ
accountMail.NotYou.vi: Nếu không phải bạn thực hiện, vui lòng liên hệ quản trị viên hệ thống.

ReauthPasswordRequired.th: โปรดกรอกรหัสผ่านปัจจุบัน
ReauthPasswordRequired.vi: Vui lòng nhập mật khẩu hiện tại

ReauthPasswordWrong.th: รหัสผ่านปัจจุบันไม่ถูกต้อง
ReauthPasswordWrong.vi: Mật khẩu hiện tại không đúng

EmailResendTooSoon.zh-TW: 驗證信剛寄過，請 {0} 秒後再試
EmailResendTooSoon.en-US: A verification email was just sent. Try again in {0} seconds
EmailResendTooSoon.th: เพิ่งส่งอีเมลยืนยันไป โปรดลองใหม่ใน {0} วินาที
EmailResendTooSoon.vi: Vừa gửi email xác minh, vui lòng thử lại sau {0} giây

accountMail.subject.recoveryCodeUsed.zh-TW: 有人用復原碼登入你的帳號
accountMail.subject.recoveryCodeUsed.en-US: Someone signed in to your account with a recovery code
accountMail.subject.recoveryCodeUsed.th: มีผู้เข้าสู่ระบบบัญชีของคุณด้วยรหัสกู้คืน
accountMail.subject.recoveryCodeUsed.vi: Có người đăng nhập vào tài khoản của bạn bằng mã khôi phục

accountMail.LinkMinutes.zh-TW: 連結 {0} 分鐘內有效，只能使用一次。
accountMail.LinkMinutes.en-US: The link is valid for {0} minutes and can be used only once.
accountMail.LinkMinutes.th: ลิงก์ใช้ได้ภายใน {0} นาทีและใช้ได้เพียงครั้งเดียว
accountMail.LinkMinutes.vi: Liên kết có hiệu lực trong {0} phút và chỉ dùng được một lần.

accountMail.intro.passwordChanged.zh-TW: 這個帳號的密碼已變更。
accountMail.intro.passwordChanged.en-US: The password for this account was changed.
accountMail.intro.passwordChanged.th: รหัสผ่านของบัญชีนี้ถูกเปลี่ยนแล้ว
accountMail.intro.passwordChanged.vi: Mật khẩu của tài khoản này đã được thay đổi.

accountMail.subject.emailChanged.zh-TW: 你的帳號 Email 已變更
accountMail.subject.emailChanged.th: อีเมลบัญชีของคุณถูกเปลี่ยนแล้ว
accountMail.subject.emailChanged.vi: Email tài khoản của bạn đã được thay đổi

accountMail.Header.th: การแจ้งเตือนบัญชี {0}

accountMail.intro.twoFactorFailures.zh-TW: 有人輸入了這個帳號的正確密碼，但驗證碼錯誤多次；驗證碼輸入已暫停 {0} 分鐘。
accountMail.intro.twoFactorFailures.en-US: Someone entered the correct password for this account but the wrong verification code many times; code entry is paused for {0} minutes.
accountMail.intro.twoFactorFailures.th: มีผู้กรอกรหัสผ่านของบัญชีนี้ถูกต้อง แต่กรอกรหัสยืนยันผิดหลายครั้ง การกรอกรหัสยืนยันถูกระงับ {0} นาที
accountMail.intro.twoFactorFailures.vi: Có người nhập đúng mật khẩu của tài khoản này nhưng nhập sai mã xác minh nhiều lần; việc nhập mã bị tạm dừng {0} phút.

accountMail.subject.emailVerify.th: ยืนยันอีเมลของคุณ
